premises.text: Existing blood analyzers detect only a handful of indications and most customers cannot afford the cost of ownership for the tests they need
premises.evidence_span: These existing blood analyzers can only detect a handful of indications, and most customers can't really pay the cost of ownership in order to cover the tests that they need

premises.text: A tiny integrated disposable device with centrifuge sample prep, spectrophotometer, and USB-C phone dongle replaces the analyzer and returns results on screen from a drop of blood
premises.evidence_span: We've done that by integrating into this tiny device, we've integrated the centrifuge, basically the drop of blood sample prep. We've integrated the spectrophotometer, and this also connects to your USB

premises.text: Pump-free modular filter and reagent design lets applications change by swapping reagents while plasma flows into tiny high-precision cuvettes
premises.evidence_span: If you want to change out the application, you just change the reagents in the filters

premises.text: ALT and AST are the launch menu because they complement blood gas analyzers and require spectrophotometric measurement
premises.evidence_span: the reason we're working with ALT and AST is because they complement the existing menus of blood gas analyzers, but they could only be measured spectrophotometrically

premises.text: Emergency veterinary critical care is the launch segment for rapid pre-admission anesthesia and drug screens
premises.evidence_span: we're launching this into the veterinary space, where emergency veterinarians could use it to run rapid screens for anesthesia or drugs before they admit the patients

premises.text: At-home dog liver monitoring is an additional customer use case
premises.evidence_span: We also have customers that are monitoring dogs at home for liver disease

premises.text: Research use on small animal blood volumes without anesthesia or terminal bleeds enables liver toxicity studies
premises.evidence_span: you could tailnick a mouse, get a small drop of blood. You don't have to anesthetize the mouse or have a terminal bleed. And you could run your liver toxicity studies

premises.text: Broader rapid chemistry expansion is viable because analytes are generic with no low-cost competitors or proprietary reagent barriers
premises.evidence_span: it has no low-cost competitors. It has only about 20 analytes that are all generic. There's no proprietary antibodies or reagents to go after. And there's no barriers to entry

premises.text: The commercial model shifts from razor-razor blade analyzers to single-use disposables
premises.evidence_span: changing the model from a razor razor blade to a single-use disposable

premises.text: Vertical integration of design and assembly controls costs
premises.evidence_span: This is how we control costs. We're vertically integrated. We've designed everything
